title: Deployment Observer: Cohort Delta Lens & Route Heatmap
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a new Console experience ("Cohort Delta Lens") that lets product and SRE teams visually compare two live rollout cohorts (control vs candidate) across per-route metrics, request traces, and output divergence signals. Include an interactive route heatmap that surfaces which API routes, models, or user segments are showing significant deltas and provide direct trace links, timeline playback, and quick actions (tag, annotate, trigger rollback). The feature will support canary, A/B, and shadow traffic patterns and tie into the rollout policy engine for automated rollback suggestions.
problem_statement: Current Console rollout surfaces are limited to single-metric timelines and don't make it easy to find per-route regressions when rollouts are multi-route or have non-uniform traffic. On-call engineers spend excessive time correlating signals across dashboards and traces before deciding to pause or rollback a rollout.
goals: Enable fast identification of route-level regressions across cohorts
Provide trace-linked evidence for individual regression signals
Integrate with rollout policies for auto-rollback suggestions and manual quick actions
Make the experience scalable for large deployments (thousands of routes / adapters)
non_goals: Replace existing full-fidelity tracing UI (keep trace linking, not full trace UX)
Ship advanced statistical hypothesis engine in phase 1 (basic significance and effect size only)
acceptance_criteria: Cohort Delta Lens shows side-by-side cohort summaries (traffic, error-rate, p50/p95 latency, token-cost) for a selected timeframe
Route Heatmap surfaces top 25 routes by effect size with filters for model, region, and tag
Clicking any heatmap cell opens a trace list filtered to that cohort+route with links to the tracing system
Delta calculations include normalized effect (percent change) and 95% CI or bootstrap p-value
Users can pin a route to a 'review list' and annotate findings; annotations persist to rollout audit log
A 'Rollback Suggestion' indicator appears when configured thresholds are breached and links to quick rollback flow
design_notes: Use compact sparklines for per-route mini-timeseries; show p95 as a bold overlay
Heatmap color scale should saturate at 3x baseline effect to avoid outlier dominance
Add 'context pill' with model-version, data-slice (cookie/region), and sample size on hover
Mobile-responsive view should collapse heatmap into a ranked list with key metrics
implementation_decisions: Backend will pre-aggregate per-route cohort stats in metrics-store (ENG-38910) rather than compute on-the-fly
Delta engine will use bootstrap resampling for small-sample routes and analytic tests for large-sample routes
Traces will be linked via trace_id list produced by rollout telemetry pipeline; we will not stream full spans into Console
Initial rollout suggestions are advisory; auto-rollback will be gated behind 'safety policy' and opt-in per-customer
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: noisy small-sample routes produce false positives. Mitigation: show sample size and hide routes below configurable min-requests threshold.
Risk: heavy UI query load for orgs with many routes. Mitigation: server-side top-K selection and pagination + caching layer.
Risk: misinterpreted delta metrics by non-technical users. Mitigation: include inline help and 'what this means' tooltips with examples.
notes: PM kickoff 2025-02-13: agreed minimal viable scope with Eng and Design. Eng requested pre-aggregated metrics to keep UI latency < 500ms for first-page load. Design: two-column layout with timeline + heatmap; will iterate on colorblind-safe palette.
